newsitem.title: USA: Mobil splits stock, raises dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mobil splits stock, raises dividend.

text.p: Mobil Corp. said Friday its directors voted a two-for-one split of the oil company's common stock.
The board also voted to increase the quarterly dividend on the common to $1.06 a share on a pre-split basis from $1, payable March 10 to holders of record Feb. 10.

The split is subject to Mobil stockholders approving an increase in the amount of authorised common stock to 1.2 billion shares from 600 million shares at the annual meeting scheduled for May 8, the company said.
At the end of 1996, Mobil noted, it had about 394 million shares of common stock outstanding.

"The stock split and dividend increase ... reflect record operating earnings in 1996, a strong balance sheet and confidence in the future of our business," Chairman Lucio Noto said. "This is the 10th year in a row that Mobil has increased the dividend payment," he added.

The pending dividend increase follows a second-quarter 1996 dividend increase by only nine months, and therefore is equivalent to an 8 percent increase on an annualized basis, the company's statement noted.
Mobil's stock gained 37.5 cents to $132.25 in late trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
